Reference / cli/command

cli/command#

Command lines: options, flags, operands and subcommands declared as data, read into an Invocation.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let add = CliCommand(name: "add", summary: "Add an item",
    options: [Option(name: "priority", short: "p", value: "N", help: "1 is urgent")],
    operands: [Operand(name: "TEXT", count: OperandCount.repeated)]);
let todo = CliCommand(name: "todo", commands: [add], flags: [Flag(name: "help", short: "h")]);

let call = todo.invocation(ProcessArguments().strings());
if call.command() == add {
    call.int("priority") else 3;
    call.operands();
}
Stdout().write(todo.usage(program: "todo"));

Description#

Command lines: options, flags, operands and subcommands declared as data, read into an Invocation.

Reading arguments has no side effects and can be repeated. A bad argument is CliFailure with its index; reading a name nothing declares is UndeclaredCliName, a mistake in the program. Values can also be layered over configuration through settings().

object CliCommand#

object CliCommand

A command: its options, flags and operands, or the subcommands it branches into. It reads an argument list into an Invocation and writes its own usage text and shell completion.

let greet = CliCommand(
    name: "greet",
    summary: "Greet one person",
    options: [Option(name: "name", short: "n", value: "NAME", help: "Person to greet")],
    flags: [Flag(name: "help", short: "h", help: "Show this help")],
);
let call = greet.invocation(ProcessArguments().strings());
if call.flag("help") { Stdout().write(greet.usage(program: "greet")); }
let person = call.text("name") else "world";

CliCommand.invocation#

invocation(arguments is Sequencing<string>) is Invocation

The arguments read by this command: values by name, the selected subcommand, the operands. A command with subcommands needs one of them, unless one of its own flags was given (tool --help): then it is the selected command. A bad argument throws CliFailure with its index. Reading is pure and repeatable.

CliCommand.usage#

The usage text of this command, wrapped to width columns.

A completion script for shell.

object Invocation#

object Invocation

Parsing is repeatable and has no I/O. Branch commands accept options then one child name, or stop at one of their own flags; leaves accept options and operands. Ancestor aliases cease to be recognized after selecting a child. -- affects the remaining complete argv. The arguments as read: the selected subcommand and every value by the name of its option, flag or operand.

let call = command.invocation(arguments);
let person = call.text("name") else "world";   // Maybe: absent is none
let count = call.int("count") else 1;           // a malformed number throws
let tags is @string = call.texts("tag");         // a repeated option
if call.flag("verbose") { … }
let files is @string = call.operands();
if call.command() == add { … }                  // the declared object

Reading a name that no command on the path declares throws UndeclaredCliName: it is a mistake in the program, not in the arguments.
